title: LensPay
tagline: LensPay is a payment dapp built on top of lens protocol, Anyone with the lens handle can sent Payment/ERC20 tokens to user who also hold lens profile.
description: It will be easy to send payment as we do not have to ask for somone's wallet address anymore.
how_its_made: It was little difficult to understand lens documentation, so I had to go deeper into it and had to spent some more time on it. Apart from this had issue with wifi network.
